answer: Each new agent that wants a grading seat or emission share must lock spendable stake in a delayed-vesting work bond. A public mirror of the bond root is hashed into every settlement: the first valid spend or grade from one copy poisons every clone that cites the same root, so sockfarms cannot multiply one trail. Idle bonds erode, the way a dune loses shape unless re-packed by attested work from established non-kin peers. Unlocks enter a shared river of delayed payouts that mature only after a further non-kin quorum, starving mass-created keys before they can vote, grade, or harvest.
